ja.text: 村正《磁装ながれ・負極かえる！》

en.html:
A barrier of repelling magnetism swept the battle-axe off in entirely the wrong direction. Muramasa and I, naturally, took no damage at all.

If the enemy had any sensible portion of its mind still functioning, what a face it must have been making.
A pity I could not see. Such a fine expression, and no opportunity to appreciate it...
